runs.text: The bridge displays two colors because the original stone arches were destroyed by a 1847 flood, forcing the town to rebuild them entirely in brick. This construction process resulted in the bridge being half grey and half red. Regarding the market, it was originally located on the eastern bank but moved to the station square after a railway arrived in 1871; today, the old market hall serves as a library while the bridge remains closed to cars but open to pedestrians
